title: Health, charities and society
intro: A short survey about health, the NHS, charities and how people in Britain get on. There are no right or wrong answers; answer as yourself.

questions.text: Which of the following health issues should be the biggest priority for the government? Select up to three
options: Investing more into research in new medicines
Encouraging healthy choices (eating well and exercising, not smoking or drinking)
Improving living conditions, such as housing and access to green spaces
Improving social care for the elderly
Increasing the availability of GP appointments

questions.text: And of those you chose in question 1, which should be the biggest priority for the government? Select only one
options: Investing more into research in new medicines
Encouraging healthy choices (eating well and exercising, not smoking or drinking)
Improving living conditions, such as housing and access to green spaces
Improving social care for the elderly
Increasing the availability of GP appointments
